scope: Actual finite-field monic-cubic elliptic point-count and source Hasse-coefficient congruence. For every finite field K with odd characteristic, q=cardK, actual nonsingular Mathlib cubic model E:y²=x³+a x²+b x+c and N=Nat.cardE.Point, derive castK(N)=1−Hq and castK(t)=Hq for the actual count-defined integer t=q+1−N (repository fieldTrace). Hq is the actual coefficient of X^(q−1) in f^((q−1)/2). Derive Hq=0 iff ringCharK divides t, and oddprimefield specialization using p exponents and p-divisibility. Actual square-root fiber Euler counts, actual finitefield power sums, strict polynomial degree coefficient extraction and unchanged actual Point/fiber equivalence supply the entire proof; no point-count/trace/coefficient/supersingularity conclusion is a premise. Generic coefficient extraction holds for actual polynomials of degree strictly below2(q−1). Exact actual nonsingular F13 curves y²=x³−x and y²=x³+4 have Point counts8/21, integer traces6/−7 and equalH13=6, directly negating unrestricted residue-uniqueness; sourceMITcorrectp>13 qualification preserved. Actual F9=GaloisField3,2/card9/char3 supplies a nonsingular curve y²=x³+a x²+1 with a²=−1, Hp=a and Hq=actualtracecast1, Hp≠actualtracecast; this distinguishes characteristic and fieldsize exponents without refuting qualified source norm relation. ActualF2 square-root helper Euler control and actualF3 X^4 nonstrict-degree-bound negation prove omitted helperguards matter. Characteristic2control is only about rootfiber helper, not a nonsingular cubic-curve counterexample. Known MIT/Sutherland classical finitefield coefficient method and p13 exercise credited, no novelty/source refutation. Does not construct canonical Frobenius endomorphism trace/geometric Hasse section, prove actual general Hasse bound/geometric supersingularity/p-rank/fulltorsionfield bridges, generic Hp-to-Hq norm identity or qualified count recovery beyond13. All prior dependencies frozen. Only standardfoundations/defaults, no holes/customaxioms/nativeproofevaluation/raisedlimits/newglobalflags/waivers/newcryptoexperiment/paidcompute/agentupload. Native header parsing/hash processing is procedural, not kernel parser/hash/execution refinement.
